same_session_common_input.semantics: Previously served same-session common input absent from first-service cache-hit counters; excludes new input. Not proof of capacity eviction or per-layer FULL/Mamba recomputation.

evicted_host_full_reaccess.semantics: Exact evicted Host-prefix reaccess attribution; overlapping eviction episodes are not unique lost bytes. Unmatched blocks remain unknown.

capacity_pressure.scope: Offline summary of existing counters. Terminal private-state reclamation and Host-backed HBM eviction are not useful-KV loss. The two loss views overlap and must not be added. Missing/zero-denominator evidence is unknown; this does not count every irreversible device drop or decode retraction.

shared_path_timing.clock: perf_counter_ns; CPU wall intervals, not GPU kernel time
shared_path_timing.scope: cumulative completed calls; exclusive totals avoid nested double counting

opportunity_writer_timing.scope: Every 64th record per category, starting with its first record. Measured processing samples only; queue waiting and status publication are excluded. Wall includes scheduling and GIL waiting; thread CPU excludes waiting. No full-run cost, GPU stall, GIL attribution or JCT saving is inferred.
